planned_nonlinear.status: Nonlinear numerical prototype implemented; exact historical agreement and continuum front convergence remain unvalidated

nonlinear_input_extension.method: Original crop/calibration retained. Four further temperature columns per curve; nearest contiguous dark-pixel run in45-pixel windows, median ordinate. Large steep-curve pixel envelopes retained.
nonlinear_input_extension.cold: Continuous declared CII-like asymptote below the plotted domain, not a recovered historical fit.
nonlinear_input_extension.low_ionization: Declared continuation of low-x collider contributions. Exposure and sensitivity reported.

nonlinear_numerics.method: Periodic equal-H-mass Lagrangian cells; compatible midpoint pressure work with compression viscosity; conservative semi-implicit conduction; coupled cooling/recombination source solve
nonlinear_numerics.coordinate: Equal-mass percentage and physical positions exported. Original zone-number mapping is not fully specified.
nonlinear_numerics.controls: Hydro energy, periodic heat Fourier mode, independent source ODE, linear-wave limit, grid/time convergence and source-domain exposure
nonlinear_numerics.original_method_evidence: p680 specifies periodic boundaries,100–200spatial mesh points, and vonNeumann–Richtmyer artificial viscosity. This implementation likewise uses no Riemann solver; it is not the recovered original program.
nonlinear_numerics.mesh_study: 64/96/128cells with96-cell displayed profiles and512-cell auxiliary comparison; field-front criterion reported separately, not assumed satisfied.
